title: 5 Reasons to Choose a Single Provider for Your MSP and MSSP Services
summary: Don't let security gaps slow you down. Learn 5 reasons a unified MSP/MSSP partner delivers smarter, faster, more compliant IT support
body_markdown:
Support for day-to-day IT operations should not stand apart from cybersecurity services. Managed Services Providers (MSPs) that do not offer sufficient cybersecurity capabilities leave their clients exposed to cyber threats.


Here are five key advantages of having cyber security be included in your MSP’s core offering.


## Security is No Longer Optional


Cyber threats like ransomware, credential theft, and email compromise are daily realities for businesses of all sizes. As a result, businesses need more than basic IT support—they often assume that their technology service provider delivers some degree of protection from modern cyber threats. If security isn’t baked into a provider’s core offering, they’re likely already falling short of expectations.


Integrating MSP and MSSP capabilities can deliver a complete, proactive solution that meets rising expectations and regulatory demands. The businesses that don’t have these combined capabilities are missing out on key benefits, while the providers that don’t offer them may be falling short of their client’s expectations.


## One Unified Team = Faster, Smarter Response


MSSPs offer advanced tools like 24/7 threat monitoring, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), and incident response. But when these functions are siloed from more standard MSP services like IT support and patching, visibility gaps and a lack of alignment between core technology teams can slow response times.


When your security and IT operations originate from a single provider, detection, response, and remediation can occur much faster. The seamless collaboration enabled by a single provider can reduce risk, minimize downtime, and provide a better overall experience.


## Deeper Alignment with Your Business


MSPs that offer security services aren’t just vendors – they’re trusted partners providing critical support. An integrated MSP/MSSP is positioned to support both day-to-day operations and long-term security goals. That means more proactive support, fewer communication gaps, and a partner advising on everything from risk management to business continuity – all with full visibility into key systems.


This alignment helps businesses move faster, stay safer, and make smarter technology decisions.


## Support Ongoing Compliance Through a Single Source of Truth


HIPAA, FedRAMP, PCI-DSS, CMMC, SEC compliance requirements continue to increase, making specialized knowledge relating to regulated industries, industry-standard software, and technical implementation even more valuable. Businesses subject to regulations need a provider that can leverage in-depth knowledge to help them stay compliant and secure.


A unified solution that closes gaps between IT and security can simplify audits, increase the efficiency of compliance efforts, and reduce the risk of non-compliance.
